name: Heartland Fabrication, LLC
old_description: At Heartland Fabrication, we take pride in offering a wide range of metal fabrication services tailored to meet your specific needs. With over 45 years of combined experience in the industry, our team is highly skilled in the design and construction of custom, production, and structural metal products that are built to last. From start to finish, we work closely with you to ensure that every project meets your exact specifications. Whether you're looking for a one-of-a-kind metal piece or a large-scale production run, we're here to bring your vision to life.
about:
Heartland Fabrication, LLC operates from Congerville, Illinois. The company was founded by two couples—Rod and Robyn Wiegand, and Troy and Dona Young—as a locally owned and operated metal fabrication shop.

The shop provides custom, production, and structural metal fabrication. Custom work includes handrails, signs, decorative trim, and custom cabinets. Production services handle large quantities of metal components for industrial machinery and custom brackets, using a state-of-the-art facility with advanced machinery. Structural projects cover steel beams, columns, metal staircases, and platforms, designed with advanced software and fabrication techniques.

Customers range from industrial manufacturers needing high-volume metal parts to homeowners and businesses seeking customized steel features for residential and commercial spaces.

The founders emphasize a mission built on quality, community, loyalty, and excellence, aiming to exceed client expectations through craftsmanship and lasting relationships.
